scope.authority: Only the native-Windows observations in this artifact are authoritative; WSL behavior is excluded.
scope.privacy: No raw argv, prompts, PIDs, tokens, environment values, or secrets are retained.

ref_snapshot.warning: Refs move; these observed SHAs are reproducibility anchors, not update authority.

canonical_selection.numeric_count_authority: The hashed Desktop/update/release logs are the source of updater and release counts. The database queries are qualitative corroboration only.

event_classes.release_terminal: one terminal status for one scheduled release invocation

rules: Sort retained updater events by timestamp in America/Los_Angeles.
Group one attempt as one contiguous staged-update sequence.
Fold repeated venv-blocked emissions within the same attempt; retain the raw-record count separately.
Count a false-success handoff only when a successful handoff initiation is followed by evidence that an install holder remained.
Define incident windows by the explicit date ranges below; do not count individual log lines as windows.
For scheduled releases from 2026-08-05 through 2026-08-10, select one terminal state per scheduled invocation.
Do not add duplicate events routed into more than one log family.

state_db.role: Qualitative title and FTS corroboration only; no numeric updater aggregate is derived from this database.
state_db.corroboration: Qualitative screenshot-title and full-text-search corpus confirmation.
state_db.session_selection_sql: SELECT source,title,datetime(started_at,'unixepoch'),datetime(COALESCE(last_activity_at,started_at),'unixepoch') FROM sessions WHERE title LIKE ? ORDER BY COALESCE(last_activity_at,started_at) DESC
state_db.fts_count_sql: SELECT COUNT(*),COUNT(DISTINCT m.session_id),MIN(datetime(m.timestamp,'unixepoch')),MAX(datetime(m.timestamp,'unixepoch')) FROM messages_fts JOIN messages m ON m.id=messages_fts.rowid WHERE messages_fts MATCH ?

live_process_snapshot.collection_method: Approved read-only native-Windows CIM observation; no WSL-derived result is included.
live_process_snapshot.selection: Exact agent.transports.hermes_tools_mcp_server module identity, aggregated without raw argv or process IDs.
